evals.prompt: Write a Google Apps Script function that saves a new member's data into a Google Sheet named 'Members' with the fields: full name, phone number, postal code, registration date
evals.expected_output: Code that forces text format for phone/postal code (setNumberFormat('@') or apostrophe prefix per spreadsheet-ops Rule #6.6), appends by header name not column index (Rule #3), stores timestamp as ISO string (Rule #6.4), and returns a {ok, ...} Result envelope with a user-facing error message on failure.

evals.prompt: Help me write GAS code that reads about 500 rows of student data from the 'Students' sheet and displays it in a web app via google.script.run
evals.expected_output: Reads the sheet once with getDataRange().getValues() (no per-row getValue loop, spreadsheet-ops Rule #1), converts Date objects to ISO strings before returning (Rule #6.1 — google.script.run cannot serialize Date), and wraps the response in a Result envelope.

evals.prompt: Build a function that generates a PDF certificate from a template sheet containing the placeholders {{NAME}} {{DATE}} — the template has a letterhead with merged cells
evals.expected_output: Copies template to a temp sheet, replaces placeholders per-cell or batch-writes only unmerged zones (never setValues over merged cells, spreadsheet-ops Rule #2), wraps generation in LockService with try/finally release (lock-service), exports via UrlFetch with OAuth token, and deletes the temp sheet.

evals.prompt: I want the system to email the admin a summary of the items still waiting for approval every day at 6 AM — please write it for me
evals.expected_output: Creates a time-driven trigger idempotently (deletes existing triggers for the same handler first, triggers.md Rule #1), notes atHour is an hour-range not exact time and depends on appsscript.json timeZone, wraps the handler in try/catch with throttled admin error notification, and checks MailApp.getRemainingDailyQuota before sending.

evals.prompt: I'm stuck — I already ran clasp push with my new code, but opening the /exec page still shows the old version. What should I do?
evals.expected_output: Explains that /exec serves the deployed version while clasp push only updates HEAD (/dev), and instructs to update the existing deployment with clasp deploy -i <deploymentId> (not a bare clasp deploy, which creates a new URL) per deployment-versioning Rules #1-#2.

evals.prompt: Help me build a username/password login system for a GAS web app that is deployed as 'execute as anyone' (anonymous access)
evals.expected_output: Hashes passwords with salt (never plain text, security Rule #3), issues a session token with expiry stored server-side instead of trusting a client-held userId (Rule #2), guards every RPC with requireSession_/requireRole_, and returns Result envelopes with user-facing messages.
